description: Land Acquisition - Katubedda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, assessment numbers, extents, and locations. The content is exclusively focused on land matters (acquisition and property descriptions) without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized categories. This fits the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which includes "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
